messages.subject: ParsedFile error
parts:
Dear All,

We are trying to write our first script and facing this ParsedFile
error.

<div style="background-color:#eee; padding: 20px 20px 20px 20px; font-
size: 14pt; border: 1px solid red;"><code>RApache Warning/Error!!!
<br><br>ParsedFile(/var/www/R/hello.R) failed!</code></div>

Our hello.R file is in /var/www/R/hello.R

<%
2+3;
%>


Our httpd.conf file
------------------------
# All Apache modules are loaded this way. The most important thing to
# remember is that the string "R_module" is case sensitive, so get it
# right in the config file.

LoadModule R_module /usr/lib/apache2/modules/mod_R.so
ROutputErrors

<Location /RApacheInfo>
SetHandler r-info
</Location>

#REvalOnStartup "library(Cairo);library(lattice)"
#RSourceOnStartup "/var/www/lib/R/startup.R"

#<Directory /var/www/test/brew>
# SetHandler r-script
# RHandler brew::brew
#</Directory>

<Directory /var/www/R>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler sys.source
</Directory>

<Location /R/hello.R>
SetHandler r-handler
RFileHandler /var/www/R/hello.R
</Location>

Any directions will be of immense help.Thanks.

Thanks,
Vasuki

messages.author: 42eed4e1caba0ad0
messages.subject: Re: ParsedFile error
parts:
...sorry for the brief reply. Here's my conf file (I'm not on Debian
distro, bare that in mind, it's not /var/www/ but /srv/http/):

<Directory /srv/http/brew>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler brew::brew
</Directory>

About your script, try either:

<%=
2+3
%>

## output:
5

or

<%
print(2+3);
%>

## output:
[1] 5

because

<%
2+3;
%>

will evaluate an expression, but will not print the result, and you'll
get an error if you put "2+3;" within <%= %>, because it's the
equivalent of print(2+3;). Semicolon is a termination string, so be
careful with it! Also take a look at the man page for brew function.
